title: HOW TO #4: Let Lava Flow Through Your Yard
caption:
How to let lava flow through your yard 🌋🔥

A volcano 2 kilometers away, and you want its lava in your yard. 10 problems, 10 fixes: a basalt channel with a stone roof, a basin, a steel gate, a fence moved back 20 meters, a tall chimney, an overflow channel. Final build: a glowing pool in your yard, controlled by a gate and an overflow channel.

Would you keep the lava pool or turn it into a stone garden? Comment LAVA below. Tag the friend who would go closest to the edge. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #5!
